name: hint
purpose: Click-open note (a "toggletip") on a small muted `az az-circle-info` glyph. A click, a tap, `Enter` or `Space` on the glyph opens a small panel, anchored below the glyph and aligned to its start, that holds one to three sentences and an optional "Learn more" link to the docs. It is level C of the in-product help standard: the way to attach a "why does this matter?" note to a field name, a setting or a column header without spending a line of vertical space on it. `Field.Label`, `SettingsRow` and `SettingsGroup` render it from their own `hint` prop.
useWhen: A field, switch or setting whose name is clear but whose consequence is not (what "Sensitive" does to a stored value).
A note of one to three sentences that is useful but not needed to complete the task, optionally with a link to the docs page that explains more.
Beside a label, a heading, a stat or a column header, where a permanent line of helper text would add noise.
avoidWhen: Information needed to fill the field → `field-description`, which stays on screen.
Naming a control or expanding an abbreviation → `tooltip`.
Help longer than three sentences, steps or several links → `help-panel`.
related: `field-description` — level A, the default: a short muted line under the field that is always visible.
`tooltip` — level B: names a control or expands an abbreviation in a few words (about 80 characters at most).
`help-panel` — level D: page-level help in the console's tools region, opened from an "Info" link after the page title.
`popover` — the overlay Hint composes; use it for interactive content.
`Field.Label`, `settings-row`, `settings-group` — render a Hint from their `hint` prop.
`/webkit-in-product-help` — the consumer skill that picks the level of help.
bestPractices: One to three plain sentences, each ending in a period.
Place the glyph 4px after the label text, on the same line. Never at the end of the row, never on its own line.
One Hint per label. Never stack two glyphs, and never put a Hint inside a Tooltip or another Hint.
Never draw a typed "?" or a boxed icon button as a help trigger; Hint is the only help glyph.
Add `href` when a docs page explains more; leave `linkLabel` empty for the localized "Learn more".
Never hide required information behind a Hint.

props.name: content
props.doc: The note, one to three sentences, shown when the glyph is clicked and read as the glyph's description.

props.name: side
props.doc: Side of the glyph the note opens on, flipped when it does not fit; `'auto'` picks the side with the most room.

props.name: href
props.doc: Docs URL linked under the note; empty renders no link.

props.name: linkLabel
props.doc: Text of the docs link; empty uses the locale catalog (`Learn more`).

props.name: ariaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the glyph button; empty uses the locale catalog (`More information`).
